item.title: Blue Note London Announces Erykah Badu, Robert Glasper & More for Inaugural Lineup
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to our podcast, where we bring you the latest news and updates from the world of music. Today, we're excited to share with you the launch of Blue Note's first U.K. venue in London, marking a significant milestone in the legendary jazz club brand's history."
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: "The 250-capacity venue, located in Covent Garden, will open its doors on September 23rd, which just so happens to be what would have been jazz icon John Coltrane's 100th birthday. And to celebrate, Grammy-winner Robert Glasper will headline the opening shows, not just once, but twice, on September 23rd and 24th, and then again for a seven-date stint in November."
[Short music clip of Robert Glasper plays]
Host: "Glasper, who's also been named creative ambassador for Blue Note London, aims to create a space where jazz, R&B, hip-hop, and everything in between can come together, evolve, and surprise audiences. And he's not the only one - other artists confirmed for the opening season include Erykah Badu, Jamie Cullum, Nubya Garcia, and many more."
[Soft music continues to play in the background]
Host: "Blue Note London will host two nightly performances at 7 p.m. and 9:30 p.m., with the venue operating until 1 a.m. from Monday to Saturday. Tickets for the first wave of shows go on general sale on August 14th, so mark your calendars! For more information and to get your tickets, head to Blue Note London's official website."
[Outro music starts to play]
Host: "That's all for today's episode. We're thrilled to see Blue Note bring its iconic jazz club brand to London, and we can't wait to see the amazing performances that will take place at this new venue. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you in the next episode!"
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
